events.evidence: The camera is mounted on a tripod and is being adjusted by the person's hand at the beginning of the video.
The person is seen putting on black gloves over their hands, which is clearly visible in the frames from 12 to 16 seconds.
The person picks up a tool (a screwdriver or similar) from the floor and holds it in their hand, which is visible in the frames from 28 to 30 seconds.
The person is seen using a tool to fasten a bolt into a metal frame, which is visible in the frames from 48 to 69 seconds.
